title: #FlybyFriday: VMAT-203 Meritorious Corporal Lives by Marine Corps Values
description: Cpl. Jordan Masters leads Marines in the ejection seat shop of Marine Attack Training Squadron 203 aboard Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C., Feb. 23, 2017. “Marines like him are going to keep the Marine Corps going,” said Staff Sgt. Stuart Vonderheide, the ejection seat shop staff noncommissioned officer in charge with VMAT-203. As a meritorious corporal, Masters is endorsed by his peers and superiors as a motivator and a positive example to follow inside and outside the workplace. Masters is a fixed-wing equipment mechanic with VMAT-203, Marine Aircraft Group 14, 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Jason Jimenez/ Released)
